concerns.text: FR-014 requires sampling from posterior distributions (multiple samples per event) to create a point‑estimate dataset that reflects uncertainty. Task T003 draws only a *single* posterior sample per event, which weakens the functional requirement and does not capture posterior variability.

FR-016 mandates correction for selection bias (detection‑efficiency weighting). Task T006 merely applies a common detection‑space cut when efficiency curves are unavailable, which is a partial/insufficient correction and thus violates the requirement.

Constitution Principle VI requires using IllustrisTNG/EAGLE simulation releases for comparison. The task set downloads or generates a synthetic power‑law catalog instead, without a ratified constitutional amendment, constituting a direct violation of the project constitution.
